steps.note: Open the existing live RFQ Responses screen with the vendor's normal bid.
Ensure the RFQ counter-offer control is available.
Ensure the tenant uses the eRFX project flow required by the case.
Send a buyer counter offer at 90 on the vendor's live bid.
Confirm the buyer's Responses grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Have the invited vendor accept the pending counter offer in the supplier portal.
Confirm the buyer's Responses grid marks the vendor's counter offer as accepted.
Open the buyer's Master QCS to inspect the accepted bid values.
Verify the accepted countered rate is reflected for the vendor.
Verify the Master QCS line amounts and total are calculated from the current displayed rates and quantities.
